findings.title: future G2 present admission is declared but not mechanically enforced
findings.observation: The contract enumerates namespace/version/interval/trusted-time/issuer/signature/trust-root/revocation/anti-replay/ambiguity/conflict/binding requirements, but check_g2 only checks that requirement keys exist. The JSON loader permits duplicate keys and the TEST_ONLY positive fixture omits algorithm, key id, certificate policy/EKU/key usage/name constraints, and source/candidate/evidence edges. The fixture is correctly barred from production, so this is not production credit; it is still insufficient as a future-present negative/positive enforcement oracle.
findings.required_action: Add a production-profile schema validator with duplicate/unknown-field rejection and explicit typed checks for every security field, plus negative fixtures for each missing/invalid security field. Keep TEST_ONLY fixtures non-admissible and separate from production profile. Re-run with raw/PID/hash evidence.
findings.claim_effect: No G2 present, UP1, B00, B04, R, L4, or parent credit may be claimed until independently reviewed.

findings.title: validation receipt lacks per-input/per-output artifact linkage
findings.observation: PID/UTC/exit and stdout/stderr/combined raw hashes are present and independently match, including PID 91276 and both failed attempts. However validation_receipt.json has no hash map binding every validator input and output artifact to the run; source manifest also has no per-input hash table. The combined raw hash therefore proves the process stream, not the complete input/output closure.
findings.required_action: Add an explicit input_artifact_hashes/output_artifact_hashes map, with manifest-self exclusion and exact-set policy, tied to PID/UTC/exit and recomputed by an independent checker. Preserve the existing raw and failed-attempt records.
findings.claim_effect: Preparation only; no formal gate credit.
